title: SSU detains suspect accused of guiding Russian strikes on defense plants and military units in Khmelnytskyi region
summary: Counterintelligence officers of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) have detained a man in the Khmelnytskyi region who is suspected of providing Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) with the coordinates of defense and civilian facilities for a new series of missile and drone attacks on the western region.
